items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tell us, you were there at the time of Trujillo, Trujillo's dictatorship.

ctx.x: Tell us, you were there at the time of Trujillo, Trujillo's dictatorship. Tell us what impressions did you have and how were you received by the Dominican people.

Very warm. Always looking back over my life in music, as always, that's what I've always tried to be - about the music, nothing more than the music. But they are a very warm people, they admired and respected me a lot. And everywhere they yelled, "Candido, Candido, Candido, Candido."
